description: Locations of 92 navigation locks (sluizen) on the Dutch recreational waterway network (BRTN), including name, address, operator, number of chambers, and VHF radio channels.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri row id (see generic).

table:columns.name: VRT_CODE
table:columns.description: Route code of the waterway in the RWS 'Vaarwegen in Nederland' (ViN) directory the lock lies on (e.g. 060 = Lemmer-Delfzijl).

table:columns.name: VRTNAAM
table:columns.description: Name of the ViN waterway/route the lock lies on.

table:columns.name: MEETPUNT
table:columns.description: Kilometre reading of the lock along the ViN route (distance from the start of the waterway description, in km).

table:columns.name: NAAM
table:columns.description: Name of the lock.

table:columns.name: ADRES
table:columns.description: Street address of the lock.

table:columns.name: POSTCODE
table:columns.description: Postal code of the lock's address.

table:columns.name: PLAATSNAAM
table:columns.description: Town where the lock is located.

table:columns.name: MARIFOONKA
table:columns.description: VHF marine radio (marifoon) channel(s) for calling the lock, stored as a list-style string, e.g. ["18"]; blank if none.

table:columns.name: NR_KOLKEN
table:columns.description: Number of lock chambers (kolken); cf. NumberOfChambers in the RWS FIS Lock schema.

table:columns.name: REF_V_BEBU
table:columns.description: Reference water level on the lower/outer side of the lock: KP=kanaalpeil, MP=meerpeil, SP=stuwpeil or NAP (FIS ReferenceLevelBeBu).

table:columns.name: REF_V_BOBI
table:columns.description: Reference water level on the upper/inner side of the lock: KP=kanaalpeil, MP=meerpeil, SP=stuwpeil or NAP (FIS ReferenceLevelBoBi).

table:columns.name: TEL_NR
table:columns.description: Phone number of the lock.

table:columns.name: AFST_BED
table:columns.description: Remotely operated (afstandsbediening), Yes/No; cf. IsRemoteControlled in the RWS FIS Lock schema.

table:columns.name: BHR_NAAM
table:columns.description: Managing organisation unit (beheerder): the RWS regional service, e.g. Zuid-Nederland.

table:columns.name: BHR_AFDELI
table:columns.description: Department/district of the manager, e.g. District Zuid-Oost.

table:columns.name: BHR_TYPE
table:columns.description: Type of managing authority; 'RWS' (Rijkswaterstaat) for all locks in this extract.

table:columns.name: BHR_BE_ADR
table:columns.description: Visiting address (bezoekadres) of the managing district office.

table:columns.name: BHR_B_PLTS
table:columns.description: Town of the manager's visiting address.

table:columns.name: BHR_POSTAD
table:columns.description: Postal address (PO box) of the manager.

table:columns.name: BHR_POS_PC
table:columns.description: Postcode of the manager's postal address.

table:columns.name: BHR_P_PLTS
table:columns.description: Town of the manager's postal address.

table:columns.name: BHR_TEL_NR
table:columns.description: Phone number of the manager.

table:columns.name: KCP_NAAM
table:columns.description: Name of the structure complex the lock belongs to (e.g. Houtribsluizen); matches RelatedBuildingComplexName in the FIS Lock schema. Blank if none.

table:columns.name: ID
table:columns.description: Numeric id of the lock in the source ViN/FIS database.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.
